PricingPage.faqDescription: Everything you need to know before starting your website project.

payment.question: Do I have to pay everything upfront?
payment.answer: Payment terms are outlined in your project proposal. For most projects, we can arrange a deposit before work begins and the remaining balance before launch.

timeline.question: How long does it take to build a website?
timeline.answer: Timelines depend on the number of pages, languages, and features. We'll provide an estimated schedule after reviewing your requirements.

domain.question: Are domain registration and hosting included?
domain.answer: Domain registration and hosting are quoted separately unless explicitly included in your proposal. We'll help you understand the available options.

languages.question: Can my website have more languages?
languages.answer: Absolutely. Each package includes a set number of languages, and additional languages can be quoted based on the amount of content.

updates.question: Can you update my website after launch?
updates.answer: Yes. Optional maintenance plans start at €29 per month. The exact services included will be defined in your maintenance agreement.

changes.question: What if I need changes during development?
changes.answer: Each package includes revision rounds. Additional changes or requests outside the agreed scope can be quoted separately.

ownership.question: Will I own my website?
ownership.answer: Ownership and access arrangements will be clearly stated in your project agreement, including any third-party services or licenses.

custom.question: What if my project doesn't fit a package?
custom.answer: No problem. Tell us what you need and we'll prepare a custom proposal based on your goals and requirements.

AboutPage.heroTitle: Thoughtful Design. Modern Technology. A Personal Approach.
AboutPage.heroDescription: Ionian Digital is an independent web development and creative design studio based in Sarandë, Albania. We combine modern technology with over a decade of hands-on hospitality experience to help local businesses make a lasting impression.
AboutPage.storyTitle: Built with Purpose. Inspired by the Ionian Coast.
AboutPage.storyParagraph1: Ionian Digital was founded with a simple idea: professional, modern websites should be accessible to businesses of all sizes.
AboutPage.storyParagraph2: Based in Sarandë, Albania, we're inspired by the creativity, hospitality, and entrepreneurial spirit of the businesses around us.
AboutPage.storyParagraph3: Our goal is to combine modern web development with personal service, helping local businesses present themselves professionally to both Albanian and international customers.
AboutPage.visualDescription: Modern websites designed to help local businesses connect with the world.
AboutPage.founderParagraph1: Hi, I'm Angelica. Before becoming a web developer, I spent over 10 years working in hospitality—from serving guests and training teams to managing restaurant operations. I've seen firsthand what it takes to keep a business running and make customers want to come back.
AboutPage.founderParagraph2: That experience shapes everything I create. I know that a customer's first impression often happens before they ever walk through the door. A clear website, an inviting menu, and an easy way to get in touch can make all the difference.
AboutPage.founderParagraph3: Today, I bring that practical understanding together with my skills in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Whether I'm building a website, designing a multilingual menu, or crafting a wine catalog, I focus on what works for both the business and its customers.
AboutPage.valuesDescription: A few simple principles guide how we approach every project.

personal.description: Every business is different. We take the time to understand your goals and create a website that reflects your needs.
